prompts.name: 01_home
prompts.prompt: Create a character design concept sheet for a minimalist pixel-art 2D platform puzzle game about emergent emotions. The attached image is the FIXED HEAD identity: retain exactly this rectangular monitor silhouette, gray bezel, two small side blocks, dark screen and cyan smiling kaomoji. Do NOT redesign the head or add antennas, hats, facial features outside the screen. Explore the BODY, ARMS, HANDS, LEGS and FEET only. One design direction per sheet: a large complete front-view robot at left, a smaller side/three-quarter view of THE SAME robot at center-right, three simple component detail studies at far right (hand, foot, chest emotional data cartridge). Restrained beautifully drawn crisp pixel art, coherent pixel sizes, small limited palette, no painted gradients, no photorealism, no complex surface greebles. Matte pale warm-gray plain background with generous negative space, no scenery, no decorative UI. Full robot fully visible with generous margins, head takes about one third of height; readable silhouette suitable for small sprites, two legs for walking and jumping. Yellow/amber small rectangular emotional-data container on chest is the sole warm color accent, cyan only on face. Simple joints so a small indie team can animate it cheaply. Small neat title at top exactly as specified. Title: '01 / HOME'. Rounded domestic companion: compact pear-shaped off-white torso, soft stepped rounded shoulders, short capsule upper arms, mitten-like two-part hands, stubby legs with broad oval slippers, small exposed navy elbow gaps. Cozy approachable gentle silhouette, round body contrasts with rectangular monitor, no armor, no weapons, no tools.
